approval.basis: User continued the female day product breakdown and GitHub handoff workflow with the street editorials.

copy.captionKo: 네이비와 올리브 사이, 길게 떨어지는 버건디.
copy.captionEn: A long burgundy line between navy and olive.
copy.captionDe: Eine lange burgunderfarbene Linie zwischen Marineblau und Oliv.
copy.introKo: 짧은 네이비 재킷 안에 화이트 셔츠와 오트밀 니트를 겹쳐요. 버건디 머플러를 길게 늘어뜨려 올리브 팬츠의 넉넉한 실루엣과 연결하고, 실버 러너와 작은 크로스바디로 가볍게 마무리해요.
copy.introEn: Layer a white shirt and oatmeal knit inside a short navy jacket. Let a burgundy scarf fall long against generous olive trousers, finishing with silver runners and a small crossbody bag.
copy.introDe: Schichte ein weißes Hemd und einen haferfarbenen Pullover unter eine kurze marineblaue Jacke. Lasse den burgunderfarbenen Schal lang über die weite olivgrüne Hose fallen und ergänze silberne Sneaker sowie eine kleine Umhängetasche.

products.descriptionKo: 앞을 열어 안쪽 레이어가 보이게 입어요. 소매와 밑단의 볼륨을 자연스럽게 남겨주세요.
products.descriptionEn: Wear it open to reveal the inner layers, keeping the natural volume of sleeves and hem.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Jacke offen, damit die inneren Lagen sichtbar bleiben, und lasse Ärmeln und Saum ihr natürliches Volumen.
products.altKo: 네이비 크롭 재킷 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: deep navy short boxy wool-look jacket with textured surface, broad spread collar, low horizontal welt pockets, relaxed straight sleeves, concealed front closure conservative

products.descriptionKo: 아우터 안에서 니트의 표면을 보여줘요. 밑단을 정돈해 와이드 하의의 여유를 살려요.
products.descriptionEn: Show the knit texture beneath the jacket and keep the hem neat above the wide trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Zeige die Strickstruktur unter der Jacke und ordne den Saum über der weiten Hose.
products.altKo: 오트밀 크루넥 니트 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: oatmeal light grey-beige crewneck knit sweater, ribbed neck cuffs hem, softly textured fine wool-look knit

products.descriptionKo: 니트 아래에 겹쳐 입고 칼라와 커프만 조금 드러내요. 몸판은 겉으로 부풀지 않게 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Layer beneath the knit, showing a little collar and cuff while keeping the body smooth.
products.descriptionDe: Trage das Hemd unter dem Strick und zeige etwas Kragen und Manschetten, während der Rumpf glatt bleibt.
products.altKo: 화이트 포인트 칼라 셔츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: white collared button shirt visible at neck under oatmeal sweater, simple pointed collar, long sleeves and concealed body conservatively reconstructed

products.descriptionKo: 넉넉한 통을 접거나 조이지 않고 자연스럽게 떨어뜨려요. 상의 밑단을 정돈해 하의의 실루엣을 드러내요.
products.descriptionEn: Let the generous legs fall naturally and keep the top hem neat so the trouser shape stays visible.
products.descriptionDe: Lasse die weiten Beine natürlich fallen und ordne das Oberteil, damit die Form der Hose sichtbar bleibt.
products.altKo: 올리브 플리츠 팬츠 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: muted olive grey-green high-rise pleated wide-leg tailored trousers, generous full length straight legs, front pleats and drapey fabric

products.descriptionKo: 목에 한 번 두르고 양 끝을 길게 늘어뜨려요. 프린지가 하의 위로 자연스럽게 이어지게 해요.
products.descriptionEn: Wrap once around the neck and let the ends fall long, with the fringe resting over the trousers.
products.descriptionDe: Lege den Schal einmal um den Hals und lasse die Enden lang über die Hose fallen.
products.altKo: 버건디 프린지 머플러 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE long burgundy wine-red wool-look scarf with subtle dark red tonal sections and fringed ends, match reference rich muted red, fully laid out neatly

products.descriptionKo: 몸 가까이 걸쳐 실루엣을 간결하게 정리해요. 스트랩은 겉옷 위에서 자연스럽게 이어줘요.
products.descriptionEn: Carry close to the body for a clean silhouette, letting the strap sit naturally over the outer layer.
products.descriptionDe: Trage die Tasche nah am Körper und lasse den Riemen natürlich über der äußeren Lage liegen.
products.altKo: 에스프레소 크로스바디 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE small espresso dark brown rounded crescent leather-look zip crossbody bag, long narrow adjustable strap, curved stitched front, match bag at waist

products.descriptionKo: 와이드 하의 아래 앞코와 솔이 드러나게 밑단 길이를 정돈해요.
products.descriptionEn: Set the trouser length so the toe and sole remain visible beneath the wide leg.
products.descriptionDe: Wähle die Hosenlänge so, dass Spitze und Sohle unter dem weiten Bein sichtbar bleiben.
products.altKo: 실버 그레이 러너 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: matching pair silver-grey mesh retro running sneakers, silver overlays, offwhite chunky soles and black toe/outsole accents, white-grey laces, no logos

products.descriptionKo: 작은 후프로 얼굴 가까이에 은은한 포인트를 더해요. 목걸이와 비슷한 금속 톤으로 정리해요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a subtle accent near the face with small earrings, keeping the metal tone coordinated.
products.descriptionDe: Setze mit kleinen Ohrringen einen dezenten Akzent am Gesicht und stimme den Metallton ab.
products.altKo: 미니 골드 후프 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE matching pair very small simple gold-tone hoop earrings based on visible earlobe; conservative hidden clasp, no other jewelry

products.descriptionKo: 얇은 링 하나로 손의 디테일을 더해요. 다른 액세서리와 골드 톤을 맞춰요.
products.descriptionEn: Add a single slim ring and coordinate its gold tone with the other accessories.
products.descriptionDe: Ergänze einen einzelnen schmalen Ring und stimme seinen Goldton auf die übrigen Accessoires ab.
products.altKo: 골드 톤 슬림 링 - 아이보리 배경의 개별 제품 컷
products.designDescriptionEn: ONE very thin plain gold-tone finger band ring based on visible hand near bag, minimal smooth circular ring only, exact metal unknown

reconstructionNotes: Hidden backs, waistbands, linings, shirt/sweater bodies and opposite shoes are conservatively reconstructed.
Small jewelry forms and hidden clasps/posts are interpreted from visible details; actual metal is unknown.
Material names describe visual appearance, not verified composition. Exact temperature and feels-like values are unknown.
excludedItems: Food, drinks, crockery, shopping paper bags and keys are scene props, not outfit products.
Socks not clearly visible; ambiguous wrist detail not identified as a watch.
